title: bug: chat_pin stores any workerId as pinnedBy, including "system" and unregistered ids that chat_send and chat_decision refuse, and chat_pin and chat_unpin refuse "#general" and unknown channels with an uncoded Error instead of resolving the reference and refusing NOT_FOUND
description:
Defect hunt #8 (task-21d671c1), lane 1: the daemon chat tool family. This row verifies hunt #7's open lead (d), "chat_pin accepts any workerId as pinnedBy". HEAD b5f40fee.

PROBLEM
1. Sender guard. packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/chatPin.ts:32-34 checks only that workerId is a non-empty string. :36 then stores it as pinnedBy: `state.pinMessage(params.channel, params.messageId, params.workerId)`. Its siblings refuse two kinds of id:
   - chat_send refuses "system" with NOT_ALLOWED (tools/chatSend.ts:41-42).
   - chat_send refuses an unregistered id with INVALID_INPUT "Unknown sender: workerId must be a registered worker or \"human\"" (chatSend.ts:44-52, after a tryLoadWorkerFromDisk fallback).
   - chat_decision applies the same pair (tools/chatDecision.ts:35-41, fixed by 314405bb).
   So a pin can be attributed to the daemon or to a seat that does not exist, in the pins file, the PINS_UPDATED broadcast and the PIN_CREATED payload (state/chatStore.ts:532-542). "human" stays allowed, as it is in chat_send. chat_pin and chat_unpin are listed in tools/list for no role except the governor (tools/index.ts:241-242, audience []), but tools/call is never filtered.
2. Channel reference. Both tools pass the raw reference straight to the store (chatPin.ts:36, chatUnpin.ts:31). The store then throws a plain `new Error('Channel not found: …')`, uncoded (-32000), for "#general" and for a channel that does not exist (state/chatStore.ts:519-520 and :549-550). Compare:
   - resolveChannelRef (chatStore.ts:88-101) says "Every chat tool that takes a channel from a caller goes through this".
   - chat_send resolves through it and refuses NOT_FOUND (chatSend.ts:55-56).

EVIDENCE
Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-21d671c1/A/chatPin.hunt.test.ts. The verbatim output is in chatPin.hunt.output.txt next to it. I re-ran it on HEAD in a git-archive snapshot: `cd /tmp/hunt-21d6-A/packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/chatPin.hunt.test.ts`. Each case first shows chat_send refusing the same input, then:
- "system": `AssertionError: promise resolved "{ success: true, pin: { …(5) } }" instead of rejecting`. The pin is stored with pinnedBy "system".
- "worker-ghost" (not registered): the same "resolved instead of rejecting".
- "#general" (the reference chat_send accepts): `AssertionError: promise rejected "Error: Channel not found: #general" instead of resolving`.

FIX DIRECTION
- chatPin.ts: copy chat_send's sender check. "system" → notAllowed. Otherwise call state.getWorker, then state.tryLoadWorkerFromDisk, else invalidInput('workerId', 'Unknown sender: …'). Then resolve the channel with `state.resolveChannelRef(params.channel)`, throw `notFound('Channel', params.channel)` on null, and pass `channel.id` to pinMessage.
- chatUnpin.ts: resolve the channel the same way and pass `channel.id`.
- Update both inputSchema channel descriptions to chat_send's wording: "Channel id, or name in either \"general\" or \"#general\" form".
- Leave the /ws PIN_MESSAGE / UNPIN_MESSAGE path (server/WebSocketServer.ts:1127/1141) unchanged.

OUT OF SCOPE (held files):
- PIN_REMOVED records no actor: chatUnpin.ts:31 drops the proxy-stamped workerId, and chatStore.ts:559 logs `{ channelId, messageId }` only. That fix needs the StateManager.unpinMessage wrapper, and state/StateManager.ts is held by task-3e1d0c2e. It is reported to the governor for after that row lands.
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md is held by task-66108835 and task-3e1d0c2e.
- chat_who, chat_join and chat_resync have the same channel-reference gap. That is a separate row filed by this hunt.

FILES: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/chatPin.ts, packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/chatUnpin.ts, and tests in a new packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/chatPin.test.ts (model it on the repro above; it uses ToolTestHarness).
definitionOfDone: `cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/chatPin.test.ts`, run in a snapshot outside the shared checkout, passes with cases that fail on HEAD b5f40fee. chat_pin with workerId "system" is refused -32003 NOT_ALLOWED. chat_pin with an unregistered id is refused -32602 INVALID_INPUT. Neither refusal stores a pin: state.getPins(channelId) stays []. "human" and a registered seat still pin.

The same test file shows chat_pin and chat_unpin accepting "#general": the pin is created and then removed under #general's canonical id. Both tools refuse a channel that does not exist with -32001 NOT_FOUND.

`npx vitest run src/state/StateManager.test.ts src/server/WebSocketServer.test.ts` stays green, so the /ws pin path still records "human". The diff touches only chatPin.ts, chatUnpin.ts and chatPin.test.ts.

comments.content: Sibling row from the same hunt (#8): task-4877ef36. It fixes the same resolveChannelRef gap in chat_who, chat_join and chat_resync, and adds chat_resync's response cap. The two rows share no file. This row owns chatPin.ts, chatUnpin.ts and a new chatPin.test.ts. task-4877ef36 owns chatWho.ts, chatJoin.ts, chatResync.ts, chatChannelRef.test.ts and chatBudgets.test.ts. So keep the pin/unpin channel cases in chatPin.test.ts, not chatChannelRef.test.ts.
